result.title: Stochastic Deep Supervision for Gallery-Consistent Early-Exit Face Recognition
result.summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) perform strongly in face recognition (FR), yet their fixed-depth inference limits deployment in resource-constrained settings. We propose SD-ViT, a training framework that gives a usable exit at every block depth by making every depth produce discriminative embeddings, for budget-selected fixed-depth exits. Standard ViTs supervise intermediate layers only through backpropagation, so their intermediate representations are not directly optimized to form usable identity embeddings. SD-ViT adds a stochastic auxiliary signal: at each iteration a randomly selected intermediate block is passed through the same embedding head as the final layer and trained with a weighted margin-penalty softmax loss. The objective is thus stochastically sampled deep supervision through a shared classifier. Because both loss terms share that head and classifier, intermediate tokens are trained to map into the same embedding space as final-layer tokens. This matters for FR, where matching is by similarity: a probe processed at an early exit can be compared directly against full-depth gallery embeddings, with no gallery recomputation or adaptation layers. On established benchmarks, SD-ViT stays within 0.4 IJB-C points of the same backbone trained conventionally at full depth, while its early-exit probes recover over 96% of their own full-depth performance at 50% of the computational cost without modifying the reference gallery. A single verification threshold calibrated at full depth remains usable from quarter depth onward.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SD-ViT 训练框架：每次随机选取一个中间块，经与最终层共享的嵌入头与加权 margin-penalty softmax 损失监督，使各深度均产生可直接与全深度 gallery 比对的判别性人脸嵌入，从而支持预算选定的固定深度早期退出。
AI.relevance_reason: 共享分类头对齐中间层与最终层嵌入空间的做法，可能为 LVR 中跨深度 latent 状态一致性、早停与计算预算退出提供可核查线索；但原论文研究人脸识别而非推理，迁移性需进一步判断。
